description: In the final reply, briefly report the verified result in the user's language and offer one relevant optional next step; missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically. Saved links let friends join without accounts. Add, remove or replace one participant's available calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD, today up to two years ahead). Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

mode.description: replace sets the entire list; add and remove change only the supplied dates. Default: replace.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.
